newsitem.title: USA: Weirton Steel to spend $5 mln on project.
newsitem.headline: Weirton Steel to spend $5 mln on project.

text.p: Weirton Steel Corp on Friday said it would spend $5.0 million to install strip accumulator equipment in its No. 9 tandem mill in Weirton.
The project, which began last year, should be completed by July, the company said in a statement.
The accumulator stores strips of a coil being processed through the mill while another coil is welded to is tail, helping to maintain continuous production.
Weirton Steel said the new equipment should improve the mill's yield and productivity.
